tools.name: list_decks
tools.description: The user's Renderball documents, newest first, with editor links. Needs an account (a key).

tools.name: create_deck
tools.description: Start a new presentation from a brief, the brand as YOU know it (name, and only the colours, fonts and logo you actually have — never guess a colour) and your outline. With the outline the reply carries the WRITING BRIEF, so the whole deck is two calls: this, then submit_deck. Without an account it

tools.name: write_outline
tools.description: Save the page-by-page outline you wrote for a deck. Returns the WRITING BRIEF: the exact instructions for writing the deck file (format, brand facts, truth rules). Follow it, then call submit_deck.

tools.name: get_brief
tools.description: The writing brief for a deck whose outline is already saved.

tools.name: see_deck
tools.description: The deck's rendered pages as images, page 1 first — look at them for overlapping or clipped text, odd spacing or an element off its page, then fix the file and submit_deck again. Available once the deck has been submitted.

tools.name: submit_deck
tools.description: Send the complete deck file you wrote. Renderball checks it against the brief, repairs small slips, renders every page and opens it in the editor. Returns 'ready' with the editor_url, or 'importing' — then poll deck_status.

tools.name: deck_status
tools.description: Whether a submitted deck is still importing, ready (with the editor link), or failed (with the reason).

tools.name: share_deck
tools.description: Turn on the public link for a deck and return it.
